# Generated by urdf2quick3dexporter.py from '/home/rutledge/dev/qt-robotics/dogzilla-digitwin/dogzilla/urdf/dogzilla.urdf' on 2026-03-24T19:26:43.953593 | License: see LICENSE
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(Robot_Dogzilla)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(QT_QML_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Quick Quick3D Ros2Core)
find_package(dogzilla_interfaces REQUIRED)
# qtros2_generate_from_package() (used below) lives in rosidl_generator_qtros2,
# whose cmake config is installed alongside Qt6Ros2Core's (see QtRos2Macros.cmake)
# rather than on the default search path -- point find_package there.
find_package(rosidl_generator_qtros2 REQUIRED PATHS "${Qt6Ros2Core_DIR}" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

qt_standard_project_setup(REQUIRES 6.8)

qt_add_library(Robot_Dogzilla)
qt_add_qml_module(Robot_Dogzilla
    URI "Dogzilla"
    NO_PLUGIN_OPTIONAL
    NO_GENERATE_PLUGIN_SOURCE
    VERSION 1.0
    RESOURCE_PREFIX "/qt/qml"
    SOURCES
        "chatmodel.h"
        "chatmodel.cpp"
        "DogzillaControlBase.h"
        "DogzillaControlBase.cpp"
        "DogzillaControl.h"
        "DogzillaControl.cpp"
        "receivedimageprovider.h"
        "receivedimageprovider.cpp"
        "motionlibrary.h"
        "motionlibrary.cpp"
    RESOURCES
        "dogzilla_joints.json"
        SOURCES lidarinstancetable.h lidarinstancetable.cpp
)

file(GLOB_RECURSE QML_SOURCES "*.qml")
add_custom_target(QmlFiles
    SOURCES ${QML_SOURCES}
)

qt_ros2_configure_target(
    Robot_Dogzilla
    CAPABILITIES PUBLISHER SUBSCRIBER SERVICE ACTION
    MODULES QtRos2GeometryMessages QtRos2SensorMessages
)

# Generate the QtRos2 QML wrapper (import Dogzilla.Interfaces) for our custom
# dogzilla_interfaces/StampedTelemetry message, via the bridge's downstream macro
# (installed with rosidl_generator_qtros2). No upstream-bridge changes needed.
# TARGET dogzilla_interfaces_msgs -> CMake target DogzillaInterfacesMsgs.
# NOTE: the URI cannot be "Dogzilla" -- that collides with our own module's
# output dir and qml_register_types_Dogzilla() symbol. A distinct URI is required.
qtros2_generate_from_package(
    SOURCE_PACKAGE dogzilla_interfaces
    TARGET dogzilla_interfaces_msgs
    QML_MODULE_URI Dogzilla.Interfaces
)

target_link_libraries(Robot_Dogzilla PUBLIC Qt6::Gui Qt6::Quick Qt6::Quick3D DogzillaInterfacesMsgs)

# The generated Dogzilla.Interfaces module is a STATIC qml plugin, which the `qml`
# runtime tool cannot dlopen. Link its plugin (+init) into our already-SHARED
# Dogzilla plugin so the module self-registers when Robot_Dogzillaplugin.so loads.
target_link_libraries(Robot_Dogzillaplugin PRIVATE
    DogzillaInterfacesMsgsplugin
    DogzillaInterfacesMsgsplugin_init)

target_sources(Robot_Dogzillaplugin PRIVATE dogzillaplugin.cpp)
